_about: An immigrant visa through the National Visa Center and a consulate (src/visa.py). The DS-260 and the documents are online only, so this 'packet' is what the firm works from: the DS-260 answer sheet and the document checklist (22 CFR 42.65, Form I-864), then the client's documents in the order NVC asks for them. Ready to scan and upload. Nothing is mailed to USCIS. The attorney approves titles and order.
title: Immigrant visa (NVC and the consulate)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

visa_sheet.title: DS-260 answer sheet and NVC document checklist
attorney_completes: The DS-260's security and background questions: answered by the client with the attorney, never from the case.

handwork.text: Submit the DS-260 and upload the documents in the Consular Electronic Application Center (ceac.state.gov), not by mail.
Pay the NVC invoice (the amounts are in the client's CEAC account), and record each date on the client's page.
Before the interview: the medical exam with the consulate's panel physician, and the originals of every document uploaded.

exhibits.title: Marriage certificate, and divorce or death certificates ending earlier marriages
Affidavit of Support evidence: the petitioner's tax returns, W-2s, pay stubs, proof of U.S. domicile
The I-130 approval and other USCIS notices
